ace.summary: ACE-neuro is a Python toolkit for processing, visualizing, and synchronizing Miniscope calcium imaging and electrophysiology recordings for neuroscience analysis.
bullets: Integrated CaImAn motion correction and CNMF-E source extraction with calcium movie cropping, detrending, normalization, and event detection.
Implemented electrophysiology artifact removal with Hann window smoothing and multitaper spectrogram analysis.
Aligned imaging frames with electrophysiology through TTL timestamps and mapped calcium events to oscillation phases for phase histograms.

chess.summary: A Java multiplayer chess application with a command-line client, HTTP and WebSocket server, user authentication, spectator support, and MySQL persistence.
bullets: Implemented chess move validation, pawn promotion, turn enforcement, and check, checkmate, and stalemate detection in a shared Java module.
Integrated Javalin HTTP endpoints and WebSocket messaging for account management, game creation, player and observer connections, board updates, and resignation.
Implemented MySQL data access with JDBC prepared statements, Gson game-state serialization, BCrypt password hashing, and UUID authentication tokens.

easy-grocer.summary: Easy Grocer is a progressive web application that generates weekly meal plans, tracks nutrition and estimated grocery costs, and provides Walmart cart handoff links.
bullets: Integrated Spoonacular recipe generation with dietary restrictions, calorie targets, fasting preferences, configurable meal patterns, and fallback mock plans.
Implemented Supabase authentication with email magic links and Google sign-in, plus transactional PostgreSQL persistence for weekly meal plans and meal items.
Developed ingredient aggregation and Walmart product resolution through SerpApi, with cached product matches, bounded concurrent requests, estimated pricing fallbacks, and cart links.

finnish-inflection-cli.summary: A Python terminal application for practicing Finnish noun, adjective, verb, and participle inflection with model-generated answers, configurable drills, and custom vocabulary sets.
bullets: Separated morphology and practice logic into a shared library with an injectable UralicNLP adapter, cached form generation, and Omorfi tag mappings.
Implemented shuffled question scheduling, alternative-answer validation, progressive letter hints, and session statistics tracking retries, hints, and skips.
Added vocabulary imports with delimiter detection, morphological validation, ambiguity overrides, atomic storage, and GitHub-hosted vocabulary set discovery and updates.

ppstats.summary: ppstats is a statistical library implementing descriptive statistics and continuous distributions in typed POST Python, supporting interpreted execution and ahead-of-time compilation to native libraries and NumPy extensions.
bullets: Implemented broadcastable reduction kernels for means, variance, central moments, skewness, kurtosis, standard error, and z-scores, plus PDF, CDF, and inverse CDF functions for six distribution families.
Added build scripts for native shared libraries, C headers, ABI manifests, and NumPy ufunc extensions, with automatic selection of compiled functions and fallback to interpreted kernels.
Developed pytest coverage using SciPy reference values, compiled-versus-interpreted comparisons, broadcasting checks, and direct C ABI calls through ctypes.

suomi-scraper.summary: Suomi Scraper converts Finnish web pages and documents into English-translated vocabulary decks for Anki through a Streamlit interface and command-line tool.
bullets: Implemented vocabulary processing with Voikko lemmatization, proper-noun filtering, recursive scripture crawling, and PDF, DOCX, and TXT ingestion.
Integrated Google translation through deep-translator with a transactional SQLite cache, language-pair isolation, and legacy JSON migration.
Built browser-based card editing and CSV export with field validation, case-insensitive deck merging, and atomic file replacement.
